notes.title: Chest Mate is out fellas!
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy crewmates![/h1]

The way to the Ocean is open! Chest Mate is out! Get ready to discover misterious islands and face their dangers to find fame and wealth! Prove yourself as a cannoneer and protect your fellow crewmate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/68e0d8cefd312b03e16f2c24ef6a131d2c308a6d.png[/img]

In this tower defense/puzzle game, your towers won't shoot automatically for you. You [b]take control of a cannon[/b] and shoot whenever you want or can. Time your shots, optimize your focus and, above all, be precise! 

You also [b]place your own walls[/b] to obstruct the way. Use your resources well and prevent your enemy from getting to you!

To help you in your endeavor, you will often find [b]interactive elements[/b]. Use them efficiently to win the day and you will soon be rich!

[h3]Optimize, be precise, get the chest, mate![/h3]
